description: Daily rounds on 34 wells for 4 customers: gauge tanks; check wells, flow lines, and tank batteries for leaks; chemical treatment; record run tickets; report gauges and problems to each customer
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Safety and environment: an unchecked tank battery can overflow or a leak can go unseen for a day; customers expect daily gauges by 9 a.m.; about $460 of pumping receipts per day; RPO is the paper gauge book plus one day
manual_workaround: Paper gauge book on rounds; call or text gauges to each customer from the phone; the nearby contract pumper covers rounds if the owner is out (informal today)
dependent_systems: SYS-04 (contacts; alarm viewer; photos); SYS-01 (gauge sheets)
dependent_third_parties: Customers A to D (alarm and gauge contacts); phone carrier
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner-operator (single point of failure); service truck; nearby contract pumper (informal)

description: Programming and troubleshooting RTUs, PLCs, rod pump controllers, flow meters, and modems for Customers A and B, on site or remotely; keeping program backups; changing setpoints on approval
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: A down controller or wrong setpoint stops a well or tank battery and can cause a release; Customer A's MSA requires approved changes; RPO 0 means every approved program version must be recoverable; replacing the laptop and licensed software takes about one working day
manual_workaround: Customer runs wells in hand mode and the hardwired shutdowns protect the tank batteries; the owner works from the customer's own copy of the program if one exists; defer non-urgent changes
dependent_systems: SYS-03 (configuration software; VPN and remote clients); SYS-06; SYS-01 (program copies); SYS-05 (customer paths)
dependent_third_parties: Customers A and B; equipment makers (software licenses); on-call IT technician
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner-operator (only programmer); laptop and programming cables

description: Daily gauge sheets; run ticket copies; service reports; responses to Customer A's questionnaire; incident notices under the MSA
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customers book sales and production reports from the daily gauge sheets; Customer A's 24-hour incident notice clause depends on email and phone
manual_workaround: Phone calls and texts with gauges; photos of the gauge book; customers' own SCADA tank levels

description: Monthly invoices to 4 customers; ACH receipts; paying helpers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Invoices go out monthly with 30-day terms; about $15,000 billed a month; a fake payment-change email to a customer could divert a month of receipts
manual_workaround: Paper invoice from a template; customers keep the owner's bank details on file and should confirm any change by phone

description: MSAs; insurance certificates; safety training records; tax records; helper W-9 forms; license files
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Deadlines are measured in days (certificates of insurance, questionnaire due 2026-09-30); W-9 data is personal information under Fla. Stat. 501.171
manual_workaround: Paper copies of MSAs and insurance certificates in the home office; agents and customers can resend documents
